# Anjali S Rameja, PhD

> Computational physicist in Bengaluru, India, building physics-aware machine-learning surrogates for atomistic simulation. Six years of molecular dynamics (LAMMPS) and density functional theory (Quantum ESPRESSO) on liquid and glassy metals, six peer-reviewed papers, and since 2026 an end-to-end workflow fine-tuning the MACE-MPA-0 atomistic foundation model and deploying it on multi-node A100 GPUs. Publishes under the author name "A. Shankar". Open to computational materials scientist and scientific ML roles.

Key facts:
- Also known as: Anjali Shankar, A. Shankar, Anjali Shankarbhai Rameja
- PhD, Physics (Computational Materials Science), Maharaja Krishnakumarsinhji (MK) Bhavnagar University, 2020 to 2026; supervisor Prof. N. K. Bhatt
- Current project (independent researcher, 2026 to present): fine-tuning the MACE-MPA-0 foundation model for Mg-Ca metallic glasses (2,000-structure DFT training set; LAMMPS on multi-node A100 GPUs at 96% weak-scaling efficiency on 8 nodes; public model release expected November 2026)
- Co-Investigator, PARAM Rudra A100 GPU allocation, National Supercomputing Mission (2026)
- Journal of Applied Physics Featured Article (2024) on Mg-Ca/Al-Ca bulk metallic glasses for bone grafting
- Contact: anjalirameja1993@gmail.com

- [Enhanced mechanical and thermophysical properties of Mg2Ca, Al2Ca, and Al4Ca bulk metallic glasses ... for bone grafting applications](https://pubs.aip.org/aip/jap/article/136/3/035107/3303611): J. Appl. Phys. 136, 035107 (2024), Featured Article
